name: Dobbs Ferry Triple-Double 2026
information:
Wednesday, September 2nd: 3x3x3 One-Handed and Megaminx
Thursday, September 3rd: 4x4x4 Cube and Skewb
Friday, September 4th: Clock and Square-1

Since there are only two events each evening and many competitors may not be able to attend every evening, there will be a **separate 20-person limit** for each event. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 40 hasn't been reached.
